sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include isoflurane as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East has 12.3 days on hand at 8.1 units per day, Corvale General has 17 days on hand at 7.7 units per day, and Corvale Lakeside has 20 days on hand at 1.4 units per day.

The top-ranked option is to buy from Mullan Pharmaceutical Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and sources from Shandong New Time Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd., last inspected VAI on 2024-07-09.
The second option is Halocarbon Life Sciences, LLC, and the third is Piramal Critical Care Inc., neither of which is on FDA's shortage list today and neither has a plant we could place.
